cabinet_reference_audit.legacy_stat: P99 over all job-cabinet contribution observations (JOB/EVENT-WEIGHTED, not time-weighted)
cabinet_reference_audit.legacy_data: all 152,400 public-snapshot jobs with usable mean_power > 0
cabinet_reference_audit.key_distinction_verbatim: The legacy P99 reference and the replayed concurrent cabinet quantity are not the same statistical object. The legacy P99 is the 99th percentile of per-job cabinet power contributions (event-weighted). The replay quantity P_c_total(t) = sum_j P_job_c(t) over overlapping observed/replayed jobs is a CONCURRENT TOTAL, not a per-job marginal. Do not describe the legacy Q_c as a time-weighted total-cabinet P99.
cabinet_reference_audit.replay_formula: P_c_total(t) = sum_j P_job_c(t) over all jobs j overlapping at time t
cabinet_reference_audit.legacy_b_cab: B_cab = sum_c integral I[P_c_total(t) > Q_c_legacy] dt

legacy_vs_corrected_reporting_rule_verba: The legacy cabinet-reference result remains the frozen pre-specified analysis. The concurrent-total-power reference is a post-exposure, reviewer-requested model-definition correction. All downstream Round-3 analyses use the corrected time-weighted reference regardless of its result. A main-text directional scheduling claim is described as robust to cabinet-reference definition only if legacy and corrected references agree in direction. If they disagree, the abstract, results, and conclusion explicitly report model-definition dependence.

e1_reinterpretation.behavior: CAB_SCALE multiplies each cabinet P99 threshold uniformly. B_ref_s (historical exceedance denominator) is computed at the FIXED base threshold (CAB_SCALE=1.0) and does NOT scale with CAB_SCALE. Verified: B_ref_s = 2449.93 s at all 5 CAB_SCALE values for sc30. B_primary_h (counterfactual exceedance) changes nonlinearly: higher CAB_SCALE -> higher threshold -> less exceedance -> lower B_primary_h -> lower B_cab_ratio.
e1_reinterpretation.label: cabinet-reference scale sensitivity, not fixed-budget sweep
e1_reinterpretation.note: Directional interpretation under legacy E1 is approximate; rerun around corrected time-weighted reference after R3-0 is accepted
e1_reinterpretation.prior_incorrect_statement_retracted: The prior statement that both counterfactual exposure AND historical B_cab denominator scale proportionally was FALSE. B_ref_s is invariant to CAB_SCALE.
